timeline.analyst_summary: Failed authentications followed by a successful authentication for the same account were observed in linked evidence. This is not proof of compromise.
recommended_checks: Confirm whether the authentication activity was expected and authorized.
Compare source IP, affected accounts, and timestamps against other authorized records.
Verify successful sessions and review subsequent host activity using other logs.
